test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six people, K, L, M, N, O and P, are sitting on the ground in a hexagonal shape but not necessarily in the same order. K is not sitting next to L or M. N is not sitting next to M or O. L is the neighbour of M. P is in the middle of M and N. What is the correct order of seating positions of the people in clockwise direction?
solution:
Six people, K, L, M, N, O and P, are sitting on the ground in a hexagonal shape but not necessarily in the same order.

1) P is in the middle of M and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50288e4b4ec5204943be9e715d425a80dff9d78f6f78dbc1e3f96001a19b6331.png] 

2) L is the neighbour of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38fff381212fb0474862594107f9920a55b12fd6f7bf56fcc017af849f6cdf23.png] 

3) N is not sitting next to M or O and K is not sitting next to L or M. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523a59f9704575764fb5c6b8deee1761805c7c56c03408dea5eda702ec7ea894.png] 

∴ Here, the seating positions of the people in clockwise direction is 'L-M-P-N-K-O'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"L-M-P-N-K-O".**
